# Brackenhill Day Unit - treatment room

Working folder for the day unit staff.

- fluids/  order cards for the treatment chairs
- stock/  consumable counts from the store

turns.prompt: A charge nurse at Brackenhill Day Unit asked how the drop factor on a giving set is used when a rate is worked out; one millilitre of fluid makes as many drops as the set's factor says. Order D-247 runs 1050 millilitres through the fifteen-drop set over 350 minutes. Give the rate for that order, in drops per minute. Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
